rule.content: WHEN bounded `Z` variables have `prime` hypotheses and a nonlinear goal resists `nia`, DO exclude only the remaining relevant composite candidates: substitute each candidate, exhibit a nontrivial divisor, destruct `prime_divisors`, discharge its four alternatives with `lia`, then retry `nia`. PROVIDED the bounds and arithmetic isolate finitely many candidates and the chosen divisor is neither `-1`, `1`, the candidate, nor its negation.

intros Hp Hq Hpp Hpq Hpbd Hqbd Heq.
assert (Hpne : Z.even p <> true).
{
  intro He.
  destruct (proj1 (Z.even_spec p) He) as [b Hb].
  destruct Hpp as [Hpp Hrel].
  specialize (Hrel 2).
  assert (Hr : 1 <= (2 : Z) < p) by lia.
  specialize (Hrel Hr).
  destruct Hrel as [H1 H2 Hrel].
  assert (Htwo : (2 | (2 : Z))%Z) by (exists 1; reflexivity).
  assert (Hpdiv : (2 | p)%Z) by (exists b; nia).
  assert (Hone : (2 | (1 : Z))%Z).
  {
    apply Hrel.
    exact Htwo.
    exact Hpdiv.
  }
  destruct Hone as [k Hk].
  lia.
}
assert (Hqne : Z.even q <> true).
{
  intro He.
  destruct (proj1 (Z.even_spec q) He) as [b Hb].
  destruct Hpq as [Hpq Hrel].
  specialize (Hrel 2).
  assert (Hr : 1 <= (2 : Z) < q) by lia.
  specialize (Hrel Hr).
  destruct Hrel as [H1 H2 Hrel].
  assert (Htwo : (2 | (2 : Z))%Z) by (exists 1; reflexivity).
  assert (Hqdiv : (2 | q)%Z) by (exists b; nia).
  assert (Hone : (2 | (1 : Z))%Z).
  {
    apply Hrel.
    exact Htwo.
    exact Hqdiv.
  }
  destruct Hone as [k Hk].
  lia.
}
assert (Hpe : Z.even p = false).
{
  destruct (Z.even p) eqn:Hev.
  - exfalso.
    exact (Hpne eq_refl).
  - reflexivity.
}
assert (Hqe : Z.even q = false).
{
  destruct (Z.even q) eqn:Hev.
  - exfalso.
    exact (Hqne eq_refl).
  - reflexivity.
}
assert (Hpo : Z.odd p = true).
{
  rewrite Zodd_even_bool, Hpe.
  reflexivity.
}
assert (Hqo : Z.odd q = true).
{
  rewrite Zodd_even_bool, Hqe.
  reflexivity.
}
destruct (proj1 (Z.odd_spec p) Hpo) as [k Hkp].
destruct (proj1 (Z.odd_spec q) Hqo) as [l Hlq].
assert (Hfour : (4 | (195 : Z))%Z).
{
  exists (k * l).
  nia.
}
destruct Hfour as [t Ht].
lia.
